game.title: Just Cause 4
game.blurb: Open-world action game of grappling, wingsuits and explosive chaos across the land of Solís, from Avalanche Studios and Square Enix, released 2018-12-04. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Operations across Solís, securing Illapa, helping Sargento, Javi Huerta and Garland King, and the Lost Tomb of Otorongo.

chapters.title: Regions, Army of Chaos and Blueprints
chapters.summary: Securing every region and factory, growing the Army of Chaos, recruiting pilots and securing blueprints.

chapters.title: Exploration and Stunts
chapters.summary: Locations, Ancient Statues, Surveillance Airships, filmed stunts, the highest point in Solís and the rigged vehicles in the harbors.

chapters.title: Trials, Challenges and Feats
chapters.summary: The Trials, the Solino Underground courses, vehicle-wrecking challenges and Feat leaderboards.

chapters.title: The Infestations
chapters.summary: Clearing the Infestation from the Mainland, the Farm, the Church, the Compound, the Lake, the Crash and the Mountain.

chapters.title: Grappling Hook and Mayhem
chapters.summary: Grappling hook mods and tether play, plane crashes, the Cow Gun and other chaos.

Fandom (justcause.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://justcause.fandom.com/wiki/Just_Cause_4
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for Just Cause 4 (API returned missing for "Just Cause 4" and for "Just Cause IV"). justcause.fandom.com answers the API, with about 118 linked pages, including "Downloadable content for Just Cause 4", "Danger Rising", "Dare Devils of Destruction", "Just Cause 4 100% completion list" and "Just Cause 4 Achievements"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Snakebite" (an internal codename); the store list names app 517630 "Just Cause 4 Reloaded". 9 of 61 Steam achievements are hidden (53 to 61); they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, but most are earned by only 1.5 to 8% of players and their names ("Drone Joust", "Long Board", "Hover or Die") suggest add-on content, which the data does not confirm. RAWG lists add-ons called "Los Demonios", "Danger Rising" and "Dare Devils of Destruction"; the Trials achievements include one named "Dare Devil of Destruction", and the Infestation achievements may be the "Los Demonios" add-on, but neither link is stated in the data, so the chapters are not named after them. "Finish The Artifact" and "Finish Extermination" were put in the main story, which is a judgement call. RAWG lists a playtime of only 5 hours, which looks low.
